_meta.name: pairwise_correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Pairwise-deletion Pearson correlation matrix of id, age and income on intake.pulse, whose blank answers are real nulls: params.missing pairwise computes each cell over the rows where both members are present instead of dropping every row with any null member, and adds auxiliary.n, the per-pair row count (300 with an id, 285 with an age, 241 with an income, 230 with both; listwise deletion would keep 230 rows for every cell, and the components carry min_pair_n / max_pair_n). A pairwise matrix need not be positive semidefinite, so predict reports pairwise_psd_risk and the run warns PULSE_MATRIX_NOT_PSD when it is not.
